origin: Original hand-drawn vector contours for these eight characters. No installed font outlines are used in the candidates.

M.change: Narrowed the broad reference M; raised and opened the internal valley. Straight stems and restrained top-corner relief.

i.change: A square dot with one-unit corner relief; aligns to the cap line, with a clear 12.5-unit separation from the body.

x.change: Redrawn intersection and diagonal widths to avoid a heavy central knot.

variants.name: Structured
variants.description: Flatter shoulders, a compact R bowl, short l foot and a restrained y return.

R.change: Replaced the curled reference leg with a straight diagonal; shaped a short vertical on the bowl and a flatter shoulder.

e.change: Flattened the outer side through its middle, opened a 13-unit aperture, and made the crossbar lighter than the verticals.

l.change: Added a short foot so l remains distinguishable and does not leave a hollow gap before a.

a.change: Redrawn double-storey a, larger lower counter and a level shoulder terminal; no curled terminal.

y.change: Straightened both arms; shortened and flattened the returning tail.

variants.name: Open
variants.description: More continuous bowls, straight l and direct diagonal y; the same M, i, x and stem system.

R.change: Same straight leg, with a fuller continuous bowl and a larger upper counter than A.

e.change: Retained the open aperture and lighter crossbar; replaced A's straight midsection with continuous curves.

l.change: Straight vertical terminal; re-spaced la independently to preserve rhythm.

a.change: The same double-storey construction with a slightly fuller upper curve; lower counter preserved.

y.change: A continuous diagonal tail with a flat end; no hook or decorative cut.

lockup.note: Study composition only; production contract remains unchanged.
